hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/.review-pending"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then rm -f "$f"; printf "%s" '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Code files changed this turn. Before finishing, run BOTH review subagents in parallel via the Agent tool, in a single message with two Agent calls: (1) subagent_type code-reviewer and (2) subagent_type security-reviewer. Tell each what the user asked for and which files changed. If either returns issues/findings, fix them and re-run that reviewer; only report the work as done once code-reviewer is CLEAN and security-reviewer has NO ISSUES. To pause this, remove the Stop hook from .claude/settings.json."}'; fi
